chapterInfo.content:
13
Asɔrefie no ho nkɔmhyɛ
(Mateo 24; Luka 21.5-36)
1Na ɔrefiri asɔrefie hɔ no, n’asuafoɔ no mu baako see no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, hwɛ aboɔ bi ne aban bi! 2Na Yesu see no sɛ: Woahunu adan akɛseɛ yi? Wɔrennya ɔboɔ a ɛda ɔboɔ so a wɔrennwiri ngu fam.
Nnoɔma a ɛbɛdi akyire
3Na ɔte Ngo Bepɔ no so asɔrefie ntentensoɔ no, Petro, Yakobo, Yohane ne Andrea bisaa no wɔ nkyɛn sɛ: 4Kyerɛ yɛn ɛberɛ ko a yeinom bɛyɛ hɔ, na yeinom nyinaa rebɛba mu a, ɛho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne deɛn? 5Na Yesu fitii aseɛ see wɔn sɛ: Monhwɛ, na obi annaadaa mo. 6Nnipa bebree bɛba me din mu abɛka sɛ: Mene no, na wɔabɛdaadaa nnipa pii. 7Na sɛ mote ɔko ne akosɛm a, mommma mo akoma nntutu. Na ɛtwa sɛ ɛba, nanso na awieeɛ no nnya nnuruiɛ. 8Na ɔman bɛsɔre ɔman so na ahennie asɔre ahennie so, na asasewosoɔ bɛba mmeammea, na ɛkɔm bɛba. Yeinom ne awoɔko yea mfitiaseɛ.
Ɔtaa ne asɛmpa no ka
(Mateo 10.17-22; Luka 21.12-17)
9 Na mo deɛ, monhwɛ mo ho yie! Na wɔbɛyi mo ama mpanimfoɔ badwa, na wɔahwe mo hyia adan mu, na me nti wɔde mo bɛgyina amradofoɔ ne ahemfo anim na moadi adanseɛ akyerɛ wɔn. 10#Mar 16.15 Na ɛtwa sɛ wɔka asɛmpa no kyerɛ amanaman nyinaa kane! 11Na sɛ wɔde mo rekɔ akɔyi mo ama a, monnnwennwene deɛ mobɛka ho ansa; na deɛ wɔde bɛma mo ɛdɔn no ara mu no, ɛno na monka, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛnyɛ mo na mokasa, na ɛyɛ Honhom Kronkron no ara.
12 Na onua bɛyi onua ama owuo, na agya ayi ɔba ama, na mma asɔre awofoɔ so, na wɔama wɔakum wɔn. 13Na me din nti, nnipa nyinaa bɛtane mo. Na deɛ ɔbɛgyina mu akɔduru awieeɛ no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.
Akyiwadeɛ a ɛbɔ ɔman
14 # Dan 9.27; 12.4; 12.10 Na sɛ mohunu akyiwadeɛ a ɛbɔ man no sɛ ɛgyina faako a ɛnsɛ no a, (ma deɛ ɔkenkan no nte aseɛ!) ɛno na ma wɔn a wɔwɔ Yudea nnwane nkɔ mmepɔ soɔ; 15na deɛ ɔwɔ ɔdan atifi no nnsiane mmma fam, nanso ɔnnhyɛne mu mmmɛfa biribi ne fie. 16Na deɛ ɔwɔ afuo mu no nnsane n’akyi mmmɛfa ne ntoma. 17Na wɔn a wɔafa afuro ne wɔn a wɔma nufoɔ nna no mu no nnue!
18 Na mommɔ mpaeɛ na amma awɔ berɛ mu. 19#Dan 12.1 Na nna no bɛyɛ ahohiahia a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn adebɔ mfitiaseɛ de bɛduru nnɛ, ebi mmaa saa da, nanso ɛremma saa bio. 20Na sɛ Awurade antwa nna no so a, anka wɔrennye ɔhonam biara nkwa; na wɔn a wɔayi wɔn, a wɔyii wɔn no nti, watwa nna no so.
21 Na ɛno na sɛ obi se mo sɛ: Hwɛ, Kristo no wɔ ha! Anaasɛ: Hwɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ! no a, monnnye nnni. 22Na Kristo atorofoɔ ne adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ bɛsɔre, na wɔabɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ, na sɛ ɛbɛtumi a, wɔbɛdaadaa wɔn a wɔayi wɔn no mpo. 23Na mo deɛ, monhwɛ yie, ɛfiri sɛ, madi kan aka ne nyinaa akyerɛ mo.
Onipa ba no ba
24 Na nna no mu ahohiahia no akyiri no,
owia bɛduru sum,
na ɔsrane renhyerɛn,
25 na ɔsoro nsoromma bɛtutu ahwe fam,
na ɔsoro ahoɔden awoso.
26 Na ɛno na wɔbɛhunu Onipa Ba no sɛ ɔde tumi kɛseɛ ne animuonyam reba mununkum mu. 27#Mat 13.41 Ɛno na ɔbɛsoma n’abɔfoɔ na wɔakɔboaboa wɔn a wayi wɔn no ano afiri mframa nnan no mu, ɛfiri asase ano kɔpem ɔsoro ano.
28 Monsua borɔdɔma ho bɛ no. Sɛ ne mman nya yɛ frɔmfrɔm, na ɛreyiyi ahahan a, na monim sɛ ahuhuro berɛ abɛn. 29Saa ara na mo nso, sɛ mohunu sɛ yeinom aba a, monhunu sɛ abɛn, na aduru apono ano! 30Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ: Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ yi rentwam, gye sɛ yeinom nyinaa aba ansa. 31Ɔsoro ne asase bɛtwam, na me nsɛm deɛ ɛrentwam da. 32Na ɛda no ne dɔn no deɛ, obi nnim, abɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ soro nso nnim, Ɔba no nso nnim, gye Agya no nko. 33Monhwɛ yie, monwɛn, na mommɔ mpaeɛ! Na monnim ɛda ko a ɛberɛ no bɛduro. 34#Mat 25.14; Luka 19.12 Ɛte sɛ onipa a watu kwan agya ne fie, na wama ne nkoa tumi, na wama wɔn nyinaa wɔn adwuma mmaako mmaako, na wahyɛ ɔpono ano hwɛfoɔ sɛ ɔnwɛn! 35#Luka 12.38 Enti monwɛn! Na monnim da ko a efiewura no bɛba, anadwofa anaa ɔdasuo mu anaa akokɔbɔneeɛ anaa anɔpa, 36na wammɛfiri mo mpofirim ammɛhu mo sɛ moadeda. 37Na deɛ mese mo yi, meka mekyerɛ nnipa nyinaa sɛ: Monwɛn!

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɔrefiri asɔrefie hɔ no, n’asuafoɔ no mu baako see no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, hwɛ aboɔ bi ne aban bi! Na Yesu see no sɛ: Woahunu adan akɛseɛ yi? Wɔrennya ɔboɔ a ɛda ɔboɔ so a wɔrennwiri ngu fam.

Na ɔte Ngo Bepɔ no so asɔrefie ntentensoɔ no, Petro, Yakobo, Yohane ne Andrea bisaa no wɔ nkyɛn sɛ: Kyerɛ yɛn ɛberɛ ko a yeinom bɛyɛ hɔ, na yeinom nyinaa rebɛba mu a, ɛho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne deɛn? Na Yesu fitii aseɛ see wɔn sɛ: Monhwɛ, na obi annaadaa mo. Nnipa bebree bɛba me din mu abɛka sɛ: Mene no, na wɔabɛdaadaa nnipa pii. Na sɛ mote ɔko ne akosɛm a, mommma mo akoma nntutu. Na ɛtwa sɛ ɛba, nanso na awieeɛ no nnya nnuruiɛ. Na ɔman bɛsɔre ɔman so na ahennie asɔre ahennie so, na asasewosoɔ bɛba mmeammea, na ɛkɔm bɛba. Yeinom ne awoɔko yea mfitiaseɛ.


Na mo deɛ, monhwɛ mo ho yie! Na wɔbɛyi mo ama mpanimfoɔ badwa, na wɔahwe mo hyia adan mu, na me nti wɔde mo bɛgyina amradofoɔ ne ahemfo anim na moadi adanseɛ akyerɛ wɔn. Na ɛtwa sɛ wɔka asɛmpa no kyerɛ amanaman nyinaa kane! Na sɛ wɔde mo rekɔ akɔyi mo ama a, monnnwennwene deɛ mobɛka ho ansa; na deɛ wɔde bɛma mo ɛdɔn no ara mu no, ɛno na monka, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛnyɛ mo na mokasa, na ɛyɛ Honhom Kronkron no ara.
Na onua bɛyi onua ama owuo, na agya ayi ɔba ama, na mma asɔre awofoɔ so, na wɔama wɔakum wɔn. Na me din nti, nnipa nyinaa bɛtane mo. Na deɛ ɔbɛgyina mu akɔduru awieeɛ no, ɔno na wɔbɛgye no nkwa.

Na sɛ mohunu akyiwadeɛ a ɛbɔ man no sɛ ɛgyina faako a ɛnsɛ no a, (ma deɛ ɔkenkan no nte aseɛ!) ɛno na ma wɔn a wɔwɔ Yudea nnwane nkɔ mmepɔ soɔ; na deɛ ɔwɔ ɔdan atifi no nnsiane mmma fam, nanso ɔnnhyɛne mu mmmɛfa biribi ne fie. Na deɛ ɔwɔ afuo mu no nnsane n’akyi mmmɛfa ne ntoma. Na wɔn a wɔafa afuro ne wɔn a wɔma nufoɔ nna no mu no nnue!
Na mommɔ mpaeɛ na amma awɔ berɛ mu. Na nna no bɛyɛ ahohiahia a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn adebɔ mfitiaseɛ de bɛduru nnɛ, ebi mmaa saa da, nanso ɛremma saa bio. Na sɛ Awurade antwa nna no so a, anka wɔrennye ɔhonam biara nkwa; na wɔn a wɔayi wɔn, a wɔyii wɔn no nti, watwa nna no so.
Na ɛno na sɛ obi se mo sɛ: Hwɛ, Kristo no wɔ ha! Anaasɛ: Hwɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ! no a, monnnye nnni. Na Kristo atorofoɔ ne adiyifoɔ atorofoɔ bɛsɔre, na wɔabɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ, na sɛ ɛbɛtumi a, wɔbɛdaadaa wɔn a wɔayi wɔn no mpo. Na mo deɛ, monhwɛ yie, ɛfiri sɛ, madi kan aka ne nyinaa akyerɛ mo.

Na nna no mu ahohiahia no akyiri no,
owia bɛduru sum,
na ɔsrane renhyerɛn,
na ɔsoro nsoromma bɛtutu ahwe fam,
na ɔsoro ahoɔden awoso.
Na ɛno na wɔbɛhunu Onipa Ba no sɛ ɔde tumi kɛseɛ ne animuonyam reba mununkum mu. Ɛno na ɔbɛsoma n’abɔfoɔ na wɔakɔboaboa wɔn a wayi wɔn no ano afiri mframa nnan no mu, ɛfiri asase ano kɔpem ɔsoro ano.
Monsua borɔdɔma ho bɛ no. Sɛ ne mman nya yɛ frɔmfrɔm, na ɛreyiyi ahahan a, na monim sɛ ahuhuro berɛ abɛn. Saa ara na mo nso, sɛ mohunu sɛ yeinom aba a, monhunu sɛ abɛn, na aduru apono ano! Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ: Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ yi rentwam, gye sɛ yeinom nyinaa aba ansa. Ɔsoro ne asase bɛtwam, na me nsɛm deɛ ɛrentwam da. Na ɛda no ne dɔn no deɛ, obi nnim, abɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ soro nso nnim, Ɔba no nso nnim, gye Agya no nko. Monhwɛ yie, monwɛn, na mommɔ mpaeɛ! Na monnim ɛda ko a ɛberɛ no bɛduro. Ɛte sɛ onipa a watu kwan agya ne fie, na wama ne nkoa tumi, na wama wɔn nyinaa wɔn adwuma mmaako mmaako, na wahyɛ ɔpono ano hwɛfoɔ sɛ ɔnwɛn! Enti monwɛn! Na monnim da ko a efiewura no bɛba, anadwofa anaa ɔdasuo mu anaa akokɔbɔneeɛ anaa anɔpa, na wammɛfiri mo mpofirim ammɛhu mo sɛ moadeda. Na deɛ mese mo yi, meka mekyerɛ nnipa nyinaa sɛ: Monwɛn!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
